dataset: ESA WorldCover 10 m (2021 v200) Land Cover Classification Raster
source: European Space Agency (ESA) / VITO Remote Sensing
coverage: Mumbai Municipal Corporation area + 10 km buffer (Lat 18.88°N–19.34°N, Lon 72.72°E–73.08°E)

classification_legend.10: Tree cover (dense evergreen/deciduous forests in Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Aarey)
classification_legend.50: Built-up (concrete impervious surface, asphalt, dense urban settlement)
classification_legend.60: Bare / sparse vegetation (Kanheri basalt rock outcrops, quarries)
classification_legend.80: Permanent water bodies (Arabian Sea, Mumbai Harbor, Powai Lake, Vihar Lake, Tulsi Lake)
classification_legend.90: Herbaceous wetland (salt pans in Wadala, Bhandup, Mulund)
classification_legend.95: Mangroves (Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary, Mahim Creek, Manori Creek)

limitations: Original discrete classification preserved without converting to imperviousness fraction, as requested. Hydrodynamic modeling pipelines should map class 50 (Built-up) to Runoff Coefficient C=0.85-0.95 and Manning's n=0.015-0.025, class 10 (Tree cover) to C=0.20-0.35 and n=0.080-0.120.
processing: Spatial extraction for Mumbai metropolitan bounds with standard LULC classification preservation.
notes: Directly usable for grid-level Manning roughness coefficient assignment and SCS-CN (Curve Number) parameterization in 2D hydraulic models.
